title: LinkedIn Job Posts Might be Misleading...
description:
Linkedin isn’t INTENTIONALLY trying to throw you off with this number and this is definitely encouraging for all job seekers! When you’re job searching and you see posts with a ton of applicants it makes you not want to apply right? Good thing that number is only the CLICKS to the application, LinkedIn doesn’t have anyway of knowing who has actually applied. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobposting #jobsearching #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #careertok #careergrowth #remotework
